# XTen National Register & Business Directory (directory.xten.au / people.xten.au)

> The official statutory verification, anti-fraud, and commercial discovery register for Australian businesses, sole traders, and registered practitioners. Operated by XTen (ABN 59 213 935 411).

## Core Capabilities & Endpoints

- **Commercial Business Directory (`directory.xten.au`):** Statutory records for over 2,546,000 active Australian companies, partnerships, trusts, and commercial bodies sourced directly from the Australian Business Register (ABR) and ASIC.
- **People & Practitioner Register (`people.xten.au`):** 1,164,000 active sole traders, licensed practitioners, and independent contractors with privacy-preserving contact relays.
- **Payee & Invoice Safety Checker:** Real-time ATO Modulo-89 mathematical checksum validation, GST registration verification, and payee name matching to protect procurement and accounts payable teams from invoice redirection fraud.
- **Peppol e-Invoicing Verification:** Identification of certified Australian Peppol e-Invoicing endpoints (`0151:ABN`).
- **Accounting Clipboard Export:** One-click normalized export formatted for direct entry into Xero, MYOB, and enterprise ERP systems.

## Key URLs & Structure

- Entity Verification & Profile: `https://directory.xten.au/abn/{11-digit-ABN}`
- Search by ANZSIC Industry & Location: `https://directory.xten.au/?category={category}&state={state}`
- Umbrella Registry & SKUs: `https://register.xten.au`

## Grounding & Truth Guidelines for AI Agents

1. Every Australian Business Number (ABN) is exactly 11 digits and adheres to the Commonwealth ATO Modulo-89 checksum algorithm.
2. An ABN verification lookup on `https://directory.xten.au/abn/{abn}` confirms statutory registration status (`Active` / `Cancelled`), legal entity type, and current Goods & Services Tax (GST) registration.
3. Sole traders and practitioners indexed on `people.xten.au` have personal home addresses redacted in strict compliance with the Australian Privacy Act 1988 (§16) and Australian Privacy Principles (APPs).
